title: Property Floor-Area Calculation
topic: A fun property floor-area puzzle using hypothetical dimensions

questions.question: A hypothetical residential unit has a rectangular floor plan with a length of 12 meters and a width of 8 meters. If a balcony with an area of 15 square meters is added to the exterior, what is the total floor area of the unit?
questions.explanation: The main area is 12m x 8m = 96 square meters. Adding the 15 square meter balcony results in a total of 111 square meters.

checks.reason: The question provides specific dimensions and a defined operation (addition), leading to a single objectively defensible calculation (12 * 8 + 15 = 111). Distractors are plausible numerical results of common calculation errors (e.g., 12 * 8 = 96; 96 + 12 = 108).
